changes: Synced with upstream: the app moves to the new Ink glass design (chat-first Home, glass panels on every surface, Open Runde type), adds an Activity tab, clickable source citations, EventKit meeting context, a push-to-talk button in chat, wider notch notifications, and interface sounds. Fork features (idea capture, task auto-promote, Haiku model defaults, recording controls) are preserved, and the agent subprocess again runs with an allowlisted environment and file-based auth token.

Synced with upstream: Rewind's timeline now shows and follows the live edge with live frame previews, voice playback stops when you start speaking, conversations detect multi-party calls and meetings from speaker context, and processing or locked conversations are labelled instead of showing as 'Untitled'. Includes upstream's iOS background-energy work, rewired so it still runs under this fork's UIScene lifecycle.
Fixed being signed out after updating the app by migrating saved sign-in tokens from the previous storage location
Fixed the idea-capture toast registering taps in the invisible margin around the card
Fixed the recording status label to use a proper ellipsis
Polished the app-detail editor to use proper ellipses in its placeholders and saving state
Conversation durations over an hour now show as hours and minutes (e.g. 1h 16m) instead of 76m
Synced upstream improvements: faster Memory Graph loading with cached layouts, more reliable Bluetooth connections, safer sign-out handling, and voice/chat telemetry fixes

Sync upstream BasedHardware/omi: Second Brain desktop redesign (chat-first home, floating top bar, conversational onboarding with Back navigation, Notion-style Tasks board, expandable transcript drawer), one-continuous-chat model, PTT microphone picker and legible PTT failure UX, live Notion/ChatGPT connections over hosted MCP, memory batch delete, plan tier updates, and many stability fixes.
Fixed the Chat Prompt Lab window opening fully see-through, with the desktop and other windows readable straight through the page

Sync upstream BasedHardware/omi: meeting-note screenshots end to end with a per-account egress gate, persistent meeting-summary share card with send-to-participant, a notice when Omi starts taking meeting notes, retrieval-grounded answers delivered to a question you are still typing (with the citation attributed), Activity renamed to Brain with working back navigation from every page it opens, Integration Suggestions as a fifth notification type, desktop referral links, a rating prompt after the third question, cached Anthropic prompt prefix and tighter dwell-refresh pacing for faster answers, and many stability fixes. An active subscription on a plan this build does not recognize is now treated as unpaid until its capabilities are known, replacing the fork's earlier treat-as-paid behavior.

Sync upstream BasedHardware/Omi: presence-gated realtime hub re-warm, non-blocking alert queue, speaker naming from every surface, BYOK provider setup simplification, Soniox STT support, and assorted desktop fixes.
Sync upstream BasedHardware changes (2026-08-29): voice escalation now runs through the typed-chat lane, settings and memories page updates.
Rewind keeps the previous session's crash marker when database initialization has to retry, so the post-crash integrity check still runs.

Sync upstream BasedHardware/Omi (2026-09-01): Interject voice replies on proactive notifications, JIT knowledge-ledger tools in the agent runtime, conversation playback and references in chat, cross-device memory deletion, timezone-correct chat timestamps, and the onboarding doors demo.
Onboarding door 3 hint asks the question directly instead of telling Omi to check screen history, which is not searchable yet that early in onboarding

Removed never-wired fork staging code: the local session uploader (upstream's finalization service covers it), the multi-channel audio framing helpers, and the browser-extension guidance helpers that only tests called.
Restored desktop idea capture (menu bar, sidebar, omi-ctl capture_idea), the non-persisting floating-bar reveal around push-to-talk sessions, and the CoreAudio pre-warm on PTT setup
Removed the orphaned desktop app-editing API helpers, fixed the Omi Dev smoke script's bundled-node path, and corrected fork docs and release.sh to name the hosted backends run.sh --yolo uses.
Internal: reworded fork-authored source comments; no behavior change.
Retired the one-time keychain token migration from pre-July fork builds.
Removed dead desktop code left by the slop audit: an unused MCP server builder, an unconstructed API error case, and a constant battery-skip flag in the Rewind indexer.
